title: Fix Extrude Curve Selection
description: When starting extrude curve interaction, user cannot select any curve. Fix curve selection in surface.extrudeCrv interaction.
summary: ExtrudeCrv after interpolate curve failed for two reasons: document/object selection was not resolved to wire primitives on interaction start, and open Nurbs wires could not be planar-extruded. Fixed by expandSelectionTargetsForAccept in core consumeStartSelection and renderer startRuntime, and open-wire extrusion via translate+loft with solid/heal/thicken fallbacks in brepjs.
